title: Fix bugs in a Node.js Express-style router
description: A simple Node.js router class has three bugs: wrong HTTP method check, missing route parameter extraction, and error handler not called on throw. Fix all three.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the three bugs in router.js:

1. BUG 1 in match(): Method comparison is case-sensitive but callers may use lowercase. Fix: `route.method !== method.toUpperCase()`
2. BUG 2 in match(): Param key includes the colon. Fix: `params[routeParts[i].slice(1)] = urlParts[i]`
3. BUG 3 in dispatch(): Handler throws are not caught. Wrap `result.handler(req, res)` in try/catch and call `errorHandler(err, req, res)` in the catch.

Run `node test_router.js` to verify (should print 'All tests passed!').
followup_prompts: Run `node test_router.js` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `node test_router.js` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
